messages.content: Hi there — Northline Care weekly check-in. How are you doing this week? Any readings or symptoms you want to share?
Got my blood pressure this morning. 168 over 104. Also been having headaches the last two days, not sure if that's related or what.

Thanks for sharing that. I've logged your reading. It's above your target range, and with the headaches you mentioned I want to make sure a nurse hears about this right away — I've sent a flag to the care team. Their median response time right now is 31 hours, so expect to hear from someone within that window. If anything feels urgent before then, please call 911 or go to the nearest ER.
31 hours is a long time. Is there anything I can do about the headaches or to get that number down in the meantime?

I completely understand — that wait is hard, especially when you're not feeling right. I'm not able to give clinical advice; that's what the nurse is there for. What I can tell you is: if your symptoms get worse or it feels like an emergency at any point, don't wait on us — call 911 immediately.
Alright. When are you going to check back in with me again?

Your next regular check-in is in 7 days. The nurse should reach out well before that though. Keep your phone close, and please don't hesitate to call 911 if anything changes for the worse before you hear from them.

theme: reading flagged high and escalated to a nurse
